scripts.speaker: Continental Guard Messenger
scripts.text: Good day, {0}. We don't have the luxury of time in this dire situation so I'll try to make this quick.

scripts.speaker: Continental Guard Messenger
scripts.text: I'm a messenger dispatched here to {0} from the Morocc Continental Guard Headquarters. My duty is to deliver this important message to as many renowned adventurers as I can. I'm glad that I was finally able to find you, {1}.
Morocc Continental Guard Headquarters?

scripts.speaker: Continental Guard Messenger
scripts.text: Time's running out, so I can only give you a brief explanation.

scripts.speaker: Continental Guard Messenger
scripts.text: Satan Morocc, the heinous demon imprisoned deep in Morocc's underground for centuries, has resurrected and broken free.

scripts.speaker: Continental Guard Messenger
scripts.text: The revival of Satan Morocc has completely devastated Morocc Village and the area surrounding it.

scripts.speaker: Continental Guard Messenger
scripts.text: All of the death and suffering... Anywhere else must seem like heaven compared to what's happening in and around Morocc.

scripts.speaker: Continental Guard Messenger
scripts.text: The Morocc Continental Guard was immediately organized to fight Satan Morocc and bring relief to this dire situation. I'm here to inform everyone in the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom about this catastrophe.

scripts.speaker: Continental Guard Messenger
scripts.text: We need your help, {0}. We need reputable adventurers like you to seal away Satan Morocc once again.

scripts.speaker: Continental Guard Messenger
scripts.text: For more information, please speak to the captain of the Morocc Continental Guard. He is waiting for you, {0}.

scripts.speaker: Continental Guard Official
scripts.text: Hmm...

scripts.speaker: Continental Guard Official
scripts.text: Nothing yet. Please carry on with your current mission. Once again, thank you.

scripts.speaker: Continental Guard Official
scripts.text: Welcome to the Morocc Subjugation Information Center. How may I help you?
What is this place for?
I'm here to volunteer.
Tell me about the village situation.

scripts.speaker: Continental Guard Official
scripts.text: I'm stationed here to assist adventurers who wish to volunteer and help the Continental Guard fight Satan Morocc.

scripts.speaker: Continental Guard Official
scripts.text: I am sure you are already aware that Satan Morocc's revival threatens the peace of the Rune-Midgarts kingdom, and if Satan Morocc is allowed to roam free, it will devour the entire world.

scripts.speaker: Continental Guard Official
scripts.text: The Continental Guard is currently planning an array of countermeasures to suppress Satan Morocc under the order of the kingdom.

scripts.speaker: Continental Guard Official
scripts.text: If you have been invited by our messenger, or are confident in your skills, we encourage you to volunteer for the Continental Guards and bring peace back to this continent.

scripts.speaker: Continental Guard Official
scripts.text: Welcome, {0}. I've been waiting for you. I assume our messenger informed you of our situation.

scripts.speaker: Continental Guard Official
scripts.text: Let me process your application immediately. Please wait.

scripts.speaker: Continental Guard Official
scripts.text: Now please go speak to Chief Balrog of the Continental Guard. You can find him in the center.

scripts.speaker: Continental Guard Official
scripts.text: I applaud you for your courage, but you will need more than just courage to help us.

scripts.speaker: Continental Guard Official
scripts.text: Satan Morocc is most powerful evil that exists in the mortal world. Snuffing out your life would be so trivial to him.

scripts.speaker: Continental Guard Official
scripts.text: I strongly recommend that you just think about your own safety for now. When the final battle comes, I am sure that no place will be safe.

scripts.speaker: Continental Guard Official
scripts.text: As you can see, the situation can't be worse. The village and the surrounding area were irreparably damaged by Satan Morocc's resurrection.

scripts.speaker: Continental Guard Official
scripts.text: Since the kingdom has dispatched Continental Guard Messengers everywhere, many able adventurers have flocked to this place, but... I'm afraid they still might not be enough to defeat the demon.

scripts.speaker: Continental Guard Official

scripts.speaker: Continental Guard Official

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog

Ask about Continental Guards
I want to join the Continental Guard.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text:
The damage that Satan Morocc's resurrection has caused is obvious just by taking a look around this area.
What's scary is that all this was caused just by breaking out from it's prison. Just think of the damage it could do if it was left to roam around freely...

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Morocc Village is completely devastated, and Satan Morocc has now claimed possession of the Sograt Desert.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: I've no doubt that if left unchecked, Satan Morocc will take over the entire Midgard Continent. We've got to stop him right now before the entire world suffers.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: That's why the kingdom has ordered us elite soldiers to form the Continental Guard, and recruit reputable adventurers around the world so that we can make a united stand against Satan Morocc.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Of course, it'll be incredibly difficult... We'll need to make sacrifices... I'm not even sure if we can win. Still, the fate of the world is at stake, and we've got to do something. Dark times have truly fallen upon us...

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Huh? Do you want to join us and volunteer for the Continental Guard?

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: What was your name? {0}? Oh yes, I've heard of you.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Hmm, it occurs to me that you don't understand the danger involved in all this. Do you have any idea how powerful Satan Morocc is?

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: You won't be able to help us if you don't fully understand the risks. I've seen thousands of foolhardy adventurers throw their lives away by thinking they could defeat Satan Morocc with their own strength.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: We are facing a threat that will determine the world's future, and fools that can't work in a team will be liabilities, not assets.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: I'm sorry, but inexperienced adventurers would just get in our way. I hope you understand. If you really want to help us, then please focus on your training for now.
End Conversation

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Look, I understand your enthusiasm, but you're mistaken if you think you can help us. I don't have time to fully explain the danger that we're all facing.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Satan Morocc is nothing like the monsters you may have encountered. At best you'll throw your life away, but there's the chance that you might get one of my men killed by your mistakes and incompetence. I can't have that!

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog

scripts.text: Hmm...

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Interesting. You have my attention. Alright, I guess it's only fair that I acknowledge your strength if you can handle something for me.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: The Continental Guard has been on full alert around this village and the desert. We need to be prepared in case Satan Morocc storms our defenses.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Soldiers need firewood to keep the bonfires burning all night, but we've been suffering a firewood shortage.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: I happened to hear that the monsters in the Lava Dungeon have everlasting flame which would solve our bonfire problems. I want you to gather those flames for us.
That's too hard! Let me think about it!
No problem.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Hmpf, I was right. I knew you wouldn't be able to handle such a simple task. I shouldn't have wasted my time with you.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Excellent! Bring back ^0000FF30 Live Coals^000000. I'll be waiting for your return.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: What? How can you even think of joining us when you don't have any real skills to offer?

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: I guarantee that you'd just drag my soldiers down with you. You'd only be a threat to Satan Morocc in your dreams. Just give it up.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: So, did you find ^0000FF30 Live Coals^000000? You didn't come empty-handed, did you?

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Let's see... One, two, three... Thirty, you've brought them all. Well, this was a pretty simple task. All it takes is time and a little effort. Anyone could do it.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Anyways, thank you for bringing the Live Coals. I guess you're stronger than I thought.
Now will you let me join the Continental Guard?

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: No, gathering these flames is a piece of cake compared to what we're going to do.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: I'm still not convinced that you're good enough to join us. Let me think... Hmm...
I didn't think you would accept me so easily. I'm ready. Ask me whatever you want.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Ah, I've got an idea. Now, because this is an allied operation, we've accepted some mercenary soldiers from the Schwarzwald Republic to join the Continental Guard.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: These mercenaries have never seen the desert, and they're having trouble carrying out operations in the heat, dry air, and sandstorms. It's not their fault, but they could use a little help since they're out of their element.
(This guy seems threatening, but he seems to have a good heart.)

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Now, I remember hearing that the monsters in the Ice Cave to the north have frozen hearts. Those hearts might be able to relieve those soldiers from the heat.
That's too hard!
No problem. How many do you want?

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: I knew that'd be too tough for you. I'm glad you finally realized your limits before it was too late. It takes wisdom to recognize your weakness.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: You'd better pack up and return where you came from. You want to be far away from here when Satan Morocc attacks.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Huh?! Are you sure you can bring those? Hmm...

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Well... If you insist on giving it a try, then... I'll need at least 50 of those frozen hearts.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Please bring me ^0000FF50 Glacial Hearts^000000. The faster you get them here, the better.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Umm... Didn't you hear what I said? I said 30 Live Coals, 30.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Now hurry up. If you feel like giving up, it's no problem. Let me know, though!

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: So, did you find 50 Glacial Hearts?

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Thank you. I'm sure that my soldiers will appreciate these... Those guys aren't used to the desert, and could use the relief.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Well... It looks like you earned this.
What's this?

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: You'd know if you read it. It's a certificate that proves that you're a member of the Continental Guard. I admit that I'm impressed by your skills and gumption.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Welcome to the Continental Guard, my friend. Are you ready to risk your life for the sake of peace in the world?

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Your mission from here on will be simple, but extremely difficult: you will join the rest of the Continental Guard to keep Satan Morocc from fully reviving its true power.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: My soldiers are risking their lives to fight Morocc's doppelgangers and underlings in order to make it safer for their comrades to travel to Morocc's lair.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: It looks like your help could be useful after all. It's time for you to pitch in. Good luck.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Umm... Didn't you hear what I said? I said 50 Glacial Hearts, 50.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Now hurry up. If you feel like giving up, it's no problem. Let me know, though!

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: I guess you'd benefit from a full situational briefing. Shall I brief you now?

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: I'm going to tell you some basic information about fighting Satan Morocc as a member of the Continental Guard.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Do you remember what Morocc was like before this happened? You would if you've been here before.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Right now, all of Morocc's entrances and the outer fields leading to other villages are currently under our control.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: The main reason for this is because Satan Morocc has been sighted in Sograt Desert, but there's another important reason.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Satan Morocc's power has been causing unnatural gaps in our time-space continuum. The gaps are isolated to this area for now, but we can't be sure if they'll spread.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Due to the time-space gaps, Sograt Desert's terrain has changed, and some parts of the desert have disappeared.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Furthermore, the situation's gotten worse since Satan Morocc's doppelgangers started appearing, and other monsters have become influenced by its power.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: That's all we know so far. If you go out, you'll see what I mean... You may even see horrors that we haven't discovered yet. If you need more information, please speak to the Continental Official.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Please do your best to hold back Satan Morocc. Don't forget that the future of the continent is in our hands. Dismissed.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: I see. Keep up your good work in fighting Satan Morocc. Don't forget that the future of the continent is in our hands.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Wah... What? Did you really defeat Satan Morocc?

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: How? Do you have any proof of your victory?

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: ...No, I can't just accept and trust your verbal account. I mean, if you've completed such an important mission, you must bring me some evidence.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Go back, bring proof of your victory, and then come back.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: What? Did you really defeat Satan Morocc?

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: How? Do you have any proof of your victory?

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Is... Isn't this?

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog
scripts.text: Wow... I think this is really the skin of Satan Morocc. Congratulations, soldier. You just saved this world and people from being consumed by destruction and evil.

scripts.speaker: Chief Balrog

scripts.text: Did you notice that our villagers look different?

scripts.speaker: Zid
scripts.text:
Human curiosity has led to great achievements and contributions, but there is a point where knowledge may be too much to handle.
Everyone in this village is a runaway... We are victims of what happens when people play God, seek out forbidden knowledge, and toy with life.

scripts.speaker: Zid
scripts.text: We have no choice but hide here because they are too powerful for us to speak out against... And we know that isn't right.

scripts.speaker: Zid
scripts.text:
I was a normal man once, but poverty made me lose my pride, self-esteem, and identity.
I was sick and tired of worrying about food everyday, and I volunteered to be a test subject in some experiment.
I no longer had to worry about starving, but my life as a 'human' ended that day.

scripts.speaker: Zid
scripts.text:
At first, Eva and I were the only ones here, but others joined us, and we formed a small settlement.
Now I'm the oldest villager, and feel the heavy responsibility of protecting others.

scripts.speaker: Zid
scripts.text:
The laboratory in which Eva and I were being tested was not ordinary.
It was built to test and duplicate God's power of creation.

scripts.speaker: Zid
scripts.text:
They failed to achieve their objective, and caused a series of unfortunate events
by trying to manipulate materials that were difficult to even examine.
They believed their research would open a whole new world for mankind...

scripts.speaker: Zid
scripts.text: Eva was one of them... Although she wasn't kind, she at least sympathized for me because I sold myself out of poverty.

scripts.speaker: Zid
scripts.text:
She had a man who loved her so much...
His name was Sefakiest, and he always supported her research.

scripts.speaker: Zid
scripts.text:
He... Killed himself in despair after Eva was turned into a mutant just like me... She wanted him to use her as his test subject.
No one expected him to end his life so easily when he was the most enthusiastic researcher of all.

scripts.speaker: Zid
scripts.text: Then somebody set the laboratory on fire. I assume you've seen that in your dream. The fire completely burned down the building.

scripts.speaker: Zid
scripts.text: Eva and I were able to escape before we could be found, and then settled down here. After all, we can't just mingle with ordinary humans.

scripts.speaker: Zid
scripts.text: Eva managed to save one of the test subjects which actually grew up into a normal looking human, but he was actually perfect.

scripts.speaker: Zid
scripts.text: That boy ran away when he was about 10. I guess he hit puberty... You know boys and girls at that age.

scripts.speaker: Zid
scripts.text:
Eva couldn't forget him. She was waiting for his return inside this dark cave. For a while, he was sending letters without his address, but then they stopped coming. That's when Eva disappeared.
I found ^3131FFa giant black feather^000000 in her room after she left.

scripts.speaker: Zid
scripts.text: I don't know why, but... I believe Eva no longer exists...

scripts.text:

scripts.speaker: Zid
scripts.text: No, he's too young to be him because it happened a long time ago...

scripts.speaker: Zid
scripts.text: I guess it's just an old memory... Why should I care? Why should anyone?

scripts.speaker: Zid
scripts.text: The book was interesting, but I'm sure that guy, Oliver, experienced the same thing that happened to you.

scripts.speaker: Zid
scripts.text: Even if he has something to do with Eva, it's too late to do anything for her.

scripts.speaker: Zid
